label: Town of Chelsea
header:
# Town of Chelsea municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 5; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Chelsea Selectboard members: Carrie Caouette-De Lallo, Curtis Chase (Vice Chair), Gregg Herrin (Chair), Paul Libby, and Charles Peel.
Town of Chelsea official website, Contacts page: lists the same five Selectboard members with the same roles (Herrin Chair, Chase Vice Chair).
Town of Chelsea official website, Selectboard page: its liaison assignments and member contacts name the same five members.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Jennifer Chase as Town Clerk of Chelsea.
Town of Chelsea official website, Contacts page: 'Town Clerk: Jennifer Chase.'
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Gayle Durkee as Treasurer of Chelsea.
Town of Chelsea official website, Contacts page: 'Treasurer & Delinquent Tax Collector: Gayle Durkee.'

Town of Chelsea official website, town news post 'Congratulations to Chelsea's 2025 elected officials!' (March 2025): the town's 2025 elected officials include 'Treasurer and Delinquent Tax Collector: Gayle Durkee' -- the office is elective in Chelsea and separately filled (17 V.S.A. section 2651d).

Town of Chelsea official website, Voting & Elections page, 'Town Offices up for Election' table for 2026: lists the Delinquent Tax Collector among the offices up for election in 2026 (one-year term), incumbent Gayle Durkee.

Town of Chelsea official website, Contacts page: 'Treasurer & Delinquent Tax Collector: Gayle Durkee' (current). The town's own 2026 results document could not be fetched; her currency rests on the town's live contacts page.

Town of Chelsea official website, town news post 'Congratulations to Chelsea's 2025 elected officials!' (March 2025): the town's 2025 elected officials include Moderator Emily Marshia (one-year term).

Town of Chelsea official website, Voting & Elections page, 'Town Offices up for Election' table for 2026: lists the Moderator among the offices up for election in 2026 (one-year term), incumbent Emily Marshia. Her term expired at the March 2026 meeting and no source read publishes the outcome, so the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed. Structure only.

Town of Chelsea official website, town news post 'Congratulations to Chelsea's 2025 elected officials!' (March 2025): the town's 2025 elected officials include Lister Phyllis Hayward; listers serve three-year staggered terms, and her seat was not among those up in 2026.

Town of Chelsea official website, Voting & Elections page, 'Town Offices up for Election' table for 2026: lists two lister seats up in 2026: a three-year seat, incumbent Susan Elder, and a one-year remainder seat, vacant. The remainder seat's outcome is not published in any source read and is left unfilled.
Town of Chelsea official website, Contacts page (current): 'Listers: Phyllis Hayward, Susan Elder.'

Town of Chelsea official website, town news post 'Congratulations to Chelsea's 2025 elected officials!' (March 2025): the town's 2025 elected officials include 'Trustee of the Public Money: David Bradshaw.' One trustee is elected each year to a three-year term (the 2026 table shows one three-year seat up), so the board is recorded with three seats.

Town of Chelsea official website, Voting & Elections page, 'Town Offices up for Election' table for 2026: lists a Trustee of Public Funds seat (three-year term) up in 2026, incumbent Edwin Coburn. His seat's outcome is not published in any source read, so he is not recorded; Bradshaw, elected in 2025 to a term running to 2028, is.

Town of Chelsea official website, town news post 'Congratulations to Chelsea's 2025 elected officials!' (March 2025): the town's 2025 elected officials list includes the Cemetery Commissioner among the elective offices ('Cemetery Commissioner: None (not enough votes)' in 2025). One commissioner is elected each year to a five-year term (the 2026 table shows one five-year seat up), so the commission is recorded with five seats; the seat that drew no election in 2025 is left unfilled.
Town of Chelsea official website, Voting & Elections page, 'Town Offices up for Election' table for 2026: lists a Cemetery Commissioner seat (five-year term) up in 2026, incumbent Steve Knudsen.

Town of Chelsea official website, Cemetery Commission page: its current personnel are Frank Keene, Shannon Doyle, Steven Knudsen, and Terry Carty. The election table prints 'Steve Knudsen'; the commission's own page prints Steven Knudsen, the form recorded here.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Chelsea justices of the peace: David Bradshaw, Susan A. Kay, Tracy S. Simon, Joseph L. Spinella, and Emily Marshia.

jp_election.name: Town of Chelsea Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Chelsea justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
